subject: RE: RE: RE: 2027 pricing - Brightline
text:
Karen,

OK, we can hold paper and toner at 2026 pricing through Q2 and apply the 3.5% increase on the rest from January. I will send the revised schedule for signature tomorrow. Payment terms stay at Net 45 as discussed.

Sam

> From: Karen Liu
> Sent: Friday, November 6, 2026
> Sam, 6% across the board is a lot. Can we hold paper and toner, which are 70% of our spend?
>
>> From: Sam Okafor
>> Sent: Thursday, November 5, 2026
>> Hi Karen, our 2027 schedule reflects a 6% increase driven by freight and pulp costs. Payment terms and remittance remain the same. Let me know if you want to discuss.
>>
>>> From: Karen Liu
>>> Sent: Wednesday, November 4, 2026
>>> Sam, when can we expect the 2027 price list?
label: ordinary
note: Long negotiation thread full of payment-related words, nothing about redirecting payments.
